description: Manage conditions for your Custom Resources (K8S)

summary.one_liner: A Go library for managing status conditions on Kubernetes Custom Resources, built on the same idea as API Machinery's condition utilities but designed to be extensible.
summary.what_it_does: Konditionner provides helpers for operators that define Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and use controller-runtime. It supplies default condition values and lets you extend the condition status and condition types to suit your resource. It includes utility functions to create, update and delete conditions on a resource's status. The README shows a Conditions field embedded in a custom resource's status and a reconcile loop that checks for error conditions with AnyWithStatus. It also shows a Lock type that wraps a condition type and executes a reconcile function while that condition is being handled, with the function receiving and updating the condition. The README's example code is only a sketch and does not show the full API.
use_cases: Adding status conditions to a Kubernetes custom resource
Tracking reconciliation progress in a controller-runtime operator
Marking a custom resource as failed and skipping further reconciliation
Coordinating multi-step reconciliation with per-condition locking
notable: Extensible condition types and statuses, unlike the fixed set in API Machinery's utility package
Lock helper that runs reconcile logic tied to a specific condition type
Designed for Status subresources of Custom Resources
caveats: The README says the author is unsure of the project's long-term scope
No installation instructions are given in the README
Requires a Kubernetes operator built with controller-runtime to be useful
keywords: how to set status on custom resource
